title: A magnitude time-arrow feature fails frozen cross-study stair-direction transfer
abstract: A signed cubic-increment statistic of phone acceleration magnitude was added to conventional orientation-invariant amplitude and spectral features for stair descent versus ascent. In WISDM (2935 windows,32 subjects), grouped out-of-fold AUC changed from0.73928 to0.75228. Source-frozen models tested on independent UCI HAR (2950 windows,30 subjects) changed AUC from0.83125 to0.80427, gain -0.02698; paired target-subject bootstrap95% interval [-0.05258,-0.00446]. A broader source-coefficient-refit/target bootstrap interval [-0.07756,0.01986] included zero. Stronger-comparator, absolute-arrow and anti-alias checks did not establish transfer improvement. This is a scoped failed-transfer result, not proof of universal harm or absence of physiological temporal information. Distinct studies differ in mounting and preprocessing; no clinical or causal claim is made. Public-input hashes, executable methods and exact author clean-rerun checks are provided.
